plan.title: $100M Leads
plan.author: Alex Hormozi
plan.confidence_note: I know the book's core frameworks well, including engaged leads, lead magnets, the Core Four, Lead Getters and the Rule of 100, but I am less certain of finer details and specific anecdotes.
plan.one_liner: Most businesses don't fail from bad products. They fail because not enough people know they exist.
plan.summary: Alex Hormozi argues that the biggest problem most businesses face is not their product but a shortage of interested people. He calls these people engaged leads. The book lays out four core ways to reach them: reaching out to people you know, posting free content, reaching out to strangers, and running paid ads. A key tool across all four is the lead magnet, a free and genuinely useful offer that solves a narrow problem and makes people want more. Once you have the basics working, Hormozi shows how to multiply your reach through Lead Getters. These are customers who refer friends, employees, agencies and affiliates who bring in leads for you. His message is simple and demanding. Do more of what works, do it better, and stay consistent long enough to see results.
